title: Conormal module generated by the codimension number of elements gives a global complete intersection nearby
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $n\ge0$, $P=k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], $I\subseteq P$ an ideal, $S=P/I$ and $\mathfrak q\subset S$ a prime ideal. Let $d=\dim_{\mathfrak q}(\operatorname{Spec}S)$ be the Krull dimension of the topological space $\operatorname{Spec}S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] at the point $\mathfrak q$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point]. Then $d$ is an integer with $0\le d\le n$; and if the localization $(I/I^2)_{\mathfrak q}$ of the $S$-module $I/I^2$ at $S\setminus\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] can be generated by $n-d$ elements as a module over the local ring $S_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], then there is $g\in S$ with $g\notin\mathfrak q$ such that the localization $S_g$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] is a global complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00SC (label lemma-lci, line 35909), implication (3) => (1), where c = height(q') - height(q) = n - dim_q(S) by Lemma 00P2 (lemma-codimension); proof lines 35937-35985: first paragraph (generators of (I/I^2)_q lift to generators of I_{q'} by Nakayama 00DV, so (3) => (2)) and third paragraph ('We continue with the notation...': clearing denominators, g' with I_{g'} = (f'_1..f'_c), g'' with dim S_{g''} = n - c, S_g = k[x_1..x_{n+1}]/(f'_1..f'_c, x_{n+1}g'g''-1))
